;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis]] meets with [[Milorad Dodik]], head of the joint [[Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina|presidency of Bosnia-Herzegovina]]. They discuss bilateral relations, the presence of the Catholic community, coexistence and reconciliation, and the economic and social challenges facing Bosnia and Herzegovina.
